Request: take-over · #30803 · PR #31006 (bare-name phase 1, PR 2 of 4) · contract review not run · maintainer order: an unreviewed PR goes to server seat 2

- #31006 is a DRAFT at `bb7864488b`, on branch `claude/project-thread-crfe5o` (the seat 3 card thread has stood down; nothing is pushed beyond that head). It covers `api`, the object-less `action` and the engine function registry. `Refs #30803`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, Tier H (ADR-0048). Dev report 6690087672.
- Owed: the contract review. Its two open questions: (1) the function door is the hook binder (`SchemaRegistry.claimBareNameFunctions`, asked by `bindHooksToEngine`), not the engine facet, so a direct `ObjectQL.registerFunction` is not judged; (2) the cold-boot warning sentence changed for every family. Then ACCEPT, `pm:awaiting-merge`, request os-zhuang / hotlong.
- Card #30803 is `pm:queue` with no assignee. Parked note 6690280341 on the card; hand-off in project files `server-lane-seat3/2026-11-06/30803/handoff.md` (rulings: cold boot B, all nine types in this card; PR3 flow/webhook/connector/email_template, PR4 agent/skill + `Fixes`). PR1 #30836 is merged.
